section_summary: This section continues a report on Japan’s April 1947 elections. It compares party platforms, gives results for local executives and assemblies and both houses of the Diet, and examines women’s participation. Its concluding analysis covers campaign finance, alleged election-law violations, turnout, uncontested races, and spoiled ballots.

subfiles.title: Report on Japan’s April 1947 Elections
subfiles.about: Analyzes Japan’s April 1947 local and national elections, including results, women’s participation, campaign conduct, and voting problems.
subfiles.summary: The opening pages finish a comparison of party programs, followed by results and analysis of elections for local executives, assemblies, and both Diet houses. A separate section assesses women’s candidacies, election, and turnout. The conclusion examines campaign finance and alleged violations, then discusses neighborhood associations, abstention, uncontested races, and invalid ballots; page 88 ends amid a table on spoiled ballots.
